work.description: Full embedded Italian motu proprio: own Pius VII protocol LF41036, Alla perfezione proem LF41044, all33 numbered rules through LF42395, full validating/derogatory closing, datum LF42473–42474 and Pius subscription LF42476. The outer Cardinal Pacca edict’s introduction LF40989–41034 and supplementary orders after LF42480 are separately attributed. Every source LF41036–42476 and surrounding context read. XML leaves308–316 confirm substantive L/R order; automated R/L/R sequences originate from running headers and marginal apparatus. LF41487 bbox [137,337,756,371] is left body plus left marginal OCR, not a join across columns. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
